description: Four by four matrix mixer: each of four inputs reaches each of four outputs through its own trimpot, with a fifth auxiliary input that has its own mute and is added to the first output

params.text: Mixes input A into output 1, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Mixes input B into output 1, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Mixes input C into output 1, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Mixes input D into output 1, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Mixes input A into output 2, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Mixes input B into output 2, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Mixes input C into output 2, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Mixes input D into output 2, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Mixes input A into output 3, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Mixes input B into output 3, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Mixes input C into output 3, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Mixes input D into output 3, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Mixes input A into output 4, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Mixes input B into output 4, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Mixes input C into output 4, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Mixes input D into output 4, silent fully anticlockwise and at full level fully clockwise
Passes the AUX input in the I position and silences it in the O position, fading over a few milliseconds rather than cutting, because the fade is modelled on a vactrol

inputs.text: One of the four signals the matrix mixes, reaching each output through the trimpot that pairs it with that output
One of the four signals the matrix mixes, reaching each output through the trimpot that pairs it with that output
One of the four signals the matrix mixes, reaching each output through the trimpot that pairs it with that output
One of the four signals the matrix mixes, reaching each output through the trimpot that pairs it with that output
A fifth input that goes through no trimpot: it passes the mute switch and the gain setting and is then added to output 1's mix at the 1+AUX jack

outputs.text: The four inputs summed through the four trimpots that pair them with output 1
The four inputs summed through the four trimpots that pair them with output 2
The four inputs summed through the four trimpots that pair them with output 3
The four inputs summed through the four trimpots that pair them with output 4
The same mix as output 1 with the AUX input added to it, after the mute switch and the gain setting

notes: the four numbered outputs report themselves to Rack as 0, 1, 2 and 3, so the hover tooltip on the jack the panel calls 1 reads 0, and each tooltip is one behind the panel
nothing limits the outputs: four 10V inputs with their trimpots fully up put 40V out of one jack, which is well past what most modules expect
the AUX mute is modelled on a VTL5C3 vactrol, opening on an exponential with a time constant of 1.25ms and closing on one of 12.5ms, recalculated every 32 samples
menu: 2x gain for Auxiliary Input — doubles the AUX input before it is added, which is the jumper on the back of the hardware this module copies
